title: Nordic economic food-access indicator profiles (SIFO / FIES / ISSP / StatFin / SE purchase)

requiredFields.geography: country-level Nordic (NO/SE/FI at minimum; DK/IS for FIES context)
requiredFields.instrument: named instrument family with item count and scoring
requiredFields.period: explicit single-year OR labeled 3-year average window; never convert between them
requiredFields.uncertainty: CI and/or design effect / margin of error when published
requiredFields.sampleN: actual analytical N and response rate when published
requiredFields.samplingMethod: country-specific procedure, not only generic World Poll text

unknownFields: FAO/FIES published point estimates for Nordic waves in open catalog metadata
full population denominator and response rate for FAO/FIES Nordic waves
country-specific sampling annex bytes beyond catalog summary
comparable single-year FAOSTAT 210090 values for Nordic countries in frozen bulk file
Finnish repeated pure multi-item food-access series equivalent to SIFO/FIES
Swedish objective purchase microdata linked to food-insecurity status
ISSP Social Inequality wave after 2019 with meal-skip item for Finland
comparisonRule: Do not derive single years from 3-year averages; do not rank countries across heterogeneous instruments; keep small cells, uncertainty, rights, and missing bridge explicit.
